page.layout: One page of running text: running head with page number at the top right; below it a genealogical table in three columns per row, with Roman numerals set centred between the rows. No margin notes, no text below the table.

main_text.l: 7. Albrecht/geborn von Sachsen/Ertzbischoff zu Mäntz[?]/gesipt im 3. grab. | Jacob/geborn von Baden/Ertzbischoff zu Trier/gesipt im 3. grab. | Ludwig/Pfalzgraff bey Rhein/Churfürst/gesipt im 4. grab/ vnd geschwägert im 2. grab.
8. Friderich/Hertzog zu Sachsen/Churfürst/gesipt im 3. grab. | Albrecht/Marggraff zu Brandeburg/geschwägert im 2. grab. | Sigmund/Ertzhertzog zu Oesterreich/Vetter/gesipt im 3. grab.
9. Carl/Hertzog zu Burgund/Schwäher/vnd als Vatter. | Albrecht/Hertzog zu Sachsen/gesipt im 2. grab. | Ludwig der alt/Hertzog in Bayern/geschwägert im 4. grab.
10. Wilhelm Hertzog zu Bayern/gesipt im 2. grab. | Ludwig/der jünger/Hertzog zu Bayern/gesipt im 2. grab. | Johan/Hertzog zu Orlicns/im 4. grab.
11. Johan/Hertzog zu Burbon/geschwägert im 4. grab. | Carl/Hertzog zu Angulem/Delphin/geschwägert im 4. grab. | Johann/Hertzog zu Alanzon/geschwägert im [?]. grab.

page.notes: Roman numerals and the symbol line ("6. t † †") are bare numbers and printed marks, written as paragraphs. Table lines are given as one line per entry, with cells separated by " | ", so the printed line breaks inside each cell are not kept. Several readings are doubtful: "Mäntz" (the printed form looks like "Mäntzuʒ"), the abbreviation at the end of the Alanzon entry, the start of the Erich entry, and the signature at the foot, which is partly cut off by the page edge. The page is cut off at the bottom, so the last row is incomplete.
